adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Topic#expandable_first_post?` from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to just `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb). Since `embeddable_hosts` setting is removed and embedding host allowlisting is now driven by `EmbeddableHost` records, there is no longer any check that embedding is “enabled” (e.g., `EmbeddableHost.exists?`). As a result, if all `EmbeddableHost` rows are deleted (blocking embedding elsewhere via `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`), existing embedded topics can still be considered expandable/truncated when `embed_truncate` is on, which matches the finding’s described behavior.
